title: Background file access
help: Downloads continue after you close this app. Each job can write only to the folder you select, for up to one hour. Existing files are never replaced.
setupHelp: Lets this app run the system tasks declared in its package.
setupHelpFiles: Lets this app finish file jobs for users after they sign out.
consentWhy: This app isn't made by Synology, and DSM doesn't let third-party apps run with system privileges.
consentPurpose: Some of its features need system privileges.
consentPurposeFiles: It needs system privileges to finish file jobs for users after they sign out.
pointPassword: Use the password of the DSM account you're signed in with now.
passwordNote: DSM checks it directly. It isn't sent to this app's service or saved.
pointLimited: The app can then run only the system tasks declared in its package, and nothing else with system privileges.
pointUpdate: If an update changes those tasks, you'll be asked to approve again.
pointRevoke: Approval adds the app's tasks to Task Scheduler. Uninstalling the app removes them and ends the approval.
consentAsk: Ask an administrator to open this app and approve it once.
confirming: Confirming background access. Do not submit again.
needs: An administrator must approve background file access.
blocked: Background file access is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the app setup.
executorBlocked: System access is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the app setup.
noticeAdmin: Some features are unavailable until you approve system access for this app.
noticeUser: Some features are unavailable until an administrator approves system access for this app.
appStopped: This app is stopped. Start it in Package Center; this page updates by itself once it runs.
appStarting: This app is starting. This page updates by itself in a moment.
appStoppedAction: This app is stopped. Start it in Package Center, then try again.
appStartingAction: This app is starting. Wait a moment, then try again.
name: File name
pending: Job canceled. Revocation is pending; the app will retry.
error: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again. If it keeps failing, contact your administrator.
setupError: Approval could not be completed. Re-enter your user password and try again, or check the app setup.
passwordConfirmFailed: DSM couldn't check the password. Nothing was changed; try again.
confirmingHelp: This can take up to a minute while the app’s background service starts and checks with DSM.
denied: Access was refused. Check your folder permissions and try again.
session: Sign in to DSM again, then refresh.
size: Downloads are limited to 64 MB and 60 seconds.
preselectionHelp: The installer pre-selection is a suggestion. Confirm this scope with your user password when enabling background access.
scopeMismatch: The installer pre-selection differs from the confirmed scope. Background saves follow the confirmed scope.
waiting_executor: Waiting for system services to start
statusUnreachable: The app's system service did not respond. Open the app from the DSM desktop or refresh the page.
statusStarting: The app's background service is still starting. Refresh the page in a moment.
upgradePrograms: System programs updated. Administrator approval is required.
upgradeTasks: Approval task definitions updated. Administrator approval is required.
upgradePolicy: Approval policy updated. Administrator approval is required.
upgradeExpanded: Permissions expanded. Review the changes before approving.
upgradeReview: Permissions or parameters changed. Review the changes before approving.
upgradeUnknown: The previous protected runtime did not provide comparison details. Changes and permission expansion cannot be determined. Administrator approval is required.
